dedupe_keys.name: hydronic heating system data from 216 us commercial buildings

description: This Dryad dataset holds time series from hydronic heating hot water systems in 216 commercial buildings belonging to 49 US organisations, compiled by Paul Raftery of the University of California, Berkeley with TRC Companies and Taylor Engineers, with funding from the California Energy Commission. It contains over 100 million building automation system measurements from 2014 to 2023; a typical building has supply and return water temperature, flow rate, heating output, system state and outdoor temperature for about 2.2 years at 15-minute intervals, and some buildings add pump and boiler data. Metadata give floor area, year of construction, building type, climate zone, heating system type and heating design day temperature, with design capacity, nominal efficiency and minimum turndown for a subset. A visualisation per building and the R code used for the paper are included. Coverage: 216 buildings across the United States, the shareable subset of the 259 analysed in the paper. Access: CSV files and code on Dryad, published 2024-07-27. Licence: CC0 1.0; free. Caveats: data were anonymised, and the variables, span and interval differ between buildings. Simulation uses are calibrating heating load and plant models, sizing and turndown studies, and testing how heating systems perform in cold weather. Related records: the End-Use Load Profiles record.
